figures.caption: FIGURE 1 Integrated framework for safety-aware battery management in electric vehicles. Battery representation, state intelligence, fast-charging control, thermal safety and fault diagnosis, cell balancing and pack coordination, and digital twins with active sensing are coupled through the BMS core. Robust validation, uncertainty quantification, multiscale integration, and standardized benchmarks are identified as key priorities for safer and longer-lasting electric-vehicle batteries.

FIGURE 2 Decision flow for a low-temperature fast-charging request. State/health/uncertainty estimates feed thermal, electrochemical, and pack gates; the safety supervisor computes the most restrictive admissible current, while charge-time optimization is performed only within that safe set. Invalid sensing or high uncertainty forces a conservative fallback.
